summary: Added a new PRECISION_OR_DEGREE_EXTRAPOLATION heuristic category to scripts/audit-claim-risk.mjs, targeting the exact unsupported-precision wording patterns that caused avoidable rework on PP-RELAY-037 (an invented 'ending before/reaches ... the central zone of the palm' fixed cutoff) and PP-RELAY-038 ('farther than average' and 'a very long line indicates...' monotonic degree scaling). The single new category combines three narrow sub-patterns via one regex: (1) average-based comparative cutoffs -- '(farther|further|longer|shorter|deeper|wider|narrower|higher|lower) than (the) average'; (2) fixed anatomical-zone cutoff phrasing tied specifically to 'central zone' ('ending before'/'reaches'/'extends to'/'stops before'/'before reaching' + 'the central zone', plus the standalone fixed phrase 'central zone of the palm'), not a general sweep of anatomical sentences; (3) monotonic degree-scaling extrapolation -- 'very (long|short|deep|wide|narrow|high|low) ... indicates' and 'the (longer|shorter|...) ... the (more|less|...)' with a bounded same-line character gap so the pattern cannot run unbounded across a whole paragraph. Added scripts/fixtures/claim-risk/risky-precision-degree.md exercising all three sub-patterns and extended scripts/fixtures/claim-risk/neutral-observational.md with the packet's own neutral example ('compare how far the line travels across this palm') to prove the new category does not flag ordinary comparative observation. Updated the self-test case list (existing risky/neutral fixtures now also assert the new category is absent/present as appropriate) and the module's top-of-file docstring to describe the new category and its originating tasks. No existing category, CLI usage, or output format changed. The new category is not wired into audit:all or any dispatch/merge/fast-lane/billing/human-gate behavior. As a sanity check (not required by the packet), ran the updated scanner against every currently published blog/lesson file: 3 findings across 89 files -- the already-known unresolved 'ending before it reaches the central zone of the palm' cutoff in src/content/lessons/lines/03-head-line.mdx (line 64, the same wording PP-RELAY-037 already identified as unsupported in the companion short-head-line article) and two 'the wider/longer ... the more' degree-scaling instances in src/content/blog/beginner/head-line.md and src/content/lessons/mounts/05-mount-of-apollo.mdx. These are heuristic review prompts surfaced for a future SOURCE_SENSITIVE task, not proof of a defect, and no published palmistry content was changed by this task. Added one dated docs/CHANGELOG.md entry describing the tooling change; no product/content state, roadmap, architecture, or durable decision changed, so no other canonical doc was touched.
